selection.ownership: Lodgify (Codebay Solutions Limited), HQ Barcelona, Spain, with UK registered entity. International Public API v2 at api.lodgify.com; not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Lodgify Public API v2 authentication (X-ApiKey), GET /v2/properties, GET /v2/properties/{id}, GET /v2/properties/{id}/rooms, GET /v2/reservations/bookings, GET /v2/reservations/bookings/{id}, Barcelona HQ, and dated incident search (Lodgify + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Lodgify Public API v2 at api.lodgify.com
research.searchCoverage: Official Lodgify Public API v2 is HTTPS JSON at https://api.lodgify.com with X-ApiKey header authentication. GET /v2/properties is the documented property list used by the pinned credential validator. Quote calculation and availability-range reads are omitted. Operator is Lodgify in Barcelona, Spain. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Lodgify platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /v2/properties?page=1&size=1&includeCount=true, matching the pinned credential validator.
Native category is scheduling (source Productivity is on the allowlist; scheduling better matches vacation-rental bookings).
Quote and availability-range reads are omitted.
Optional page, size, and includeCount match documented query names. Official size maximum is 50; native bounds size 1-50. Returns raw Lodgify JSON under data.
propertyId is a required positive integer path segment on documented GET /v2/properties/{id}. Returns raw Lodgify JSON under data.

Pinned source maps list_property_rooms to GET /v2/properties/{propertyId}/rooms. Official property docs describe room types on the property resource; native follows the pinned rooms path. Returns the raw Lodgify array under data.
Pinned source maps list_bookings to GET /v2/reservations/bookings with optional page, size, and stayFilter. Official size maximum is 50. stayFilter enum matches pinned Upcoming/Current/Historic/All.
Returns raw Lodgify JSON under data.
Pinned source maps get_booking to GET /v2/reservations/bookings/{bookingId}. Returns raw Lodgify JSON under data.

enquiries.callmeback.create.title: Create call-me-back request
enquiries.callmeback.create.description: Create a Call Me Back enquiry via POST /v1/reservation/callmeback. Returns the created enquiry id.

guest_breakdown.description: Breakdown of guests for the booking or enquiry (adults, children, infants, pets).

guest.description: Guest making the enquiry (name, email, phone, address).

thread_id.description: Messaging thread UUID to link this enquiry.

ip_created.description: IP address where the enquiry was created.

source_text.description: Textual description of the enquiry source.

source_address.description: Sender email if the enquiry originated from email.

has_privacy_consent.description: Whether the guest has given privacy consent.

date.description: Scheduled call-back date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

duration.description: Duration of the appointment in hours. Default is 2.

notes.description: Additional notes for the call-back request.

time_zone_info_id.description: IANA time zone identifier for the appointment time.

enquiries.create.title: Create enquiry
enquiries.create.description: Create a general enquiry via POST /v1/reservation/enquiry. Returns the created enquiry id.

guest_breakdown.description: Breakdown of guests for the booking or enquiry (adults, children, infants, pets).

guest.description: Guest making the enquiry (name, email, phone, address).

thread_id.description: Messaging thread UUID to link this enquiry.

ip_created.description: IP address where the enquiry was created.

source_text.description: Textual description of the enquiry source.

source_address.description: Sender email if the enquiry originated from email.

has_privacy_consent.description: Whether the guest has given privacy consent.

enquiries.delete.title: Delete enquiry
enquiries.delete.description: Move an enquiry to the trash via DELETE /v1/reservation/enquiry/{id}.

reservations.delete.title: Delete reservations
reservations.delete.description: Batch-move bookings and enquiries to the trash via POST /v1/reservation/delete. Body is a JSON array of {id, type}.

countries.list.title: List countries
countries.list.description: List available country codes via GET /v1/countries.

countries.get.title: Get country
countries.get.description: Get one country by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code via GET /v1/countries/{code}.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, FR).

currencies.get.title: Get currency
currencies.get.description: Get one currency by ISO 4217 code via GET /v1/currencies/{code}.

code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

properties.deleted.list.title: List deleted properties
properties.deleted.list.description: List deleted property IDs via GET /v2/deletedproperties, optionally filtered by deletedSince.

deletedSince.description: ISO 8601 datetime; only properties deleted since this instant.

bookings.external.list.title: List external bookings
bookings.external.list.description: List external bookings for a Lodgify booking via GET /v2/reservations/bookings/{id}/externalBookings.

messaging.threads.get.title: Get messaging thread
messaging.threads.get.description: Get a messaging thread via GET /v2/messaging/{threadGuid}.

threadGuid.description: Thread UUID from reservation thread_uid or guest_message_received webhooks.

availability.property.get.title: Get property availability
availability.property.get.description: Get v2 availability for a property via GET /v2/availability/{propertyId}. Composio periodStart/periodEnd map to official start/end.

periodStart.description: Start of the calendar period (maps to official query start).

periodEnd.description: End of the calendar period (maps to official query end).

availability.room-type.get.title: Get room type availability
availability.room-type.get.description: Get v2 availability for a room type via GET /v2/availability/{propertyId}/{roomTypeId}.

reservations.unread.get.title: Get unread count
reservations.unread.get.description: Get the unread booking and enquiry count via GET /v1/reservation/not_read. Returns an integer.

availability.v1.list.title: List v1 availability
availability.v1.list.description: Get v1 availability across properties via GET /v1/availability.

ModifiedSince.description: Include only sub-periods modified after this date.

CombineRoomTypes.description: Combine room types into a single house total.

currencies.list.title: List currencies
currencies.list.description: List available currency codes via GET /v1/currencies.

reservations.list.title: List reservations
reservations.list.description: List bookings and enquiries from the v1 inbox via GET /v1/reservation. Distinct from v2 bookings.list.

periodStart.description: Return items starting from this date.

periodEnd.description: Return items ending before this date.

modifiedSince.description: Return items modified after this datetime.

reservations.mark-not-replied.title: Mark reservations not replied
reservations.mark-not-replied.description: Batch-mark bookings and enquiries as not replied via POST /v1/reservation/not-replied. Body is a JSON array of {id, type}.

reservations.mark-replied.title: Mark reservations replied
reservations.mark-replied.description: Batch-mark bookings and enquiries as replied via POST /v1/reservation/replied. Body is a JSON array of {id, type}.

enquiries.recover.title: Recover enquiry
enquiries.recover.description: Restore a trashed enquiry via PUT /v1/reservation/enquiry/{id}/recover.

availability.set.title: Set availability
availability.set.description: Set available units for a room type via POST /v1/availability/{propertyId}/{roomTypeId}/set.

period_start.description: Start of the period to update (ISO 8601).

period_end.description: End of the period to update (ISO 8601).

available.description: Number of units to set as available.

webhooks.subscribe.title: Subscribe webhook
webhooks.subscribe.description: Subscribe a callback URL to a Lodgify event via POST /webhooks/v1/subscribe. Returns id and secret.

target_url.description: Unique callback URL Lodgify will POST when the event fires.

webhooks.unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe webhook
webhooks.unsubscribe.description: Remove a webhook subscription via DELETE /webhooks/v1/unsubscribe with JSON body {id}.
